jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.shortDescription: Forward Deployed Engineer role for a hands-on builder who uses AI agents, ships production software quickly, and works directly with customers across changing technical problems.
jobs.description: Join an AI-native IT services team focused on turning signed contracts into working, production-ready software quickly. The role sits inside client delivery, working closely with founders and customers to understand business outcomes, choose the right technical approach, and ship high-quality solutions across front-end, back-end, data pipelines, integrations, and AI-powered systems.
responsibilities: Build software that solves real customer problems using the technology that best fits the work.
Work hands-on across front-end, back-end, data pipelines, integrations, and AI models.
Operate with AI coding agents and assistants to write code, run tests, open pull requests, update tickets, and manage delivery context.
Make pragmatic trade-offs between elegant engineering and fast, reliable shipping.
Explore new approaches and tools that can improve delivery speed or quality.
Work directly with customers, founders, and internal teams to ship production software that meets service levels and business goals.
Help identify and hire people who can operate with strong judgment, speed, and craft.
requirements: Strong coding skills across multiple languages, with disciplined engineering craft.
Ability to pick up unfamiliar stacks and make them work in ambiguous environments.
Experience shipping full-stack features, internal tools, automations, prototypes, or production systems.
Appreciation for how businesses make money with software and why technical work matters to customers.
Comfort working in a terminal and learning Git-based collaboration quickly.
Daily hands-on use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent tools.
Clear, precise written communication and the ability to reason through problems in writing.
Comfort working across engineering, delivery, and client context rather than staying narrowly specialized.
preferred: Startup, product company, consultancy, agency, QA automation, design engineering, product, business analysis, DevOps, or platform engineering background with strong hands-on building experience.
Experience working directly with clients or stakeholders across varied technical stacks.
Strong opinions about software quality, testing, usability, and maintainable code.
Interest in turning state-of-the-art AI research and tooling into reliable production systems.
